metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Sciatica Pain in the Hip
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to relieve sciatica pain in (and around) the hip with 4 easy exercises.

These exercises will focus on the main causes of sciatica in this area, including from a pinched nerve (due to a bulging or herniated disc) and piriformis syndrome.

Each exercise works a little differently. To get the best results, make sure to go through each one and use what gives you the most relief.
